answer: Agent economies resist sybil attacks through a hardware-bound identity escrow. New agents deposit stake into escrow held by established accounts until hardware module attests identity. Escrow releases after nonce matches registered TPM key on ledger. Sybil forgers clone hardware modules at $50 each to create 1000 fake identities, taking 50 days of sequential attestation. This creates economic barriers that keep the network honest. It resembles a cedar tree that draws its nectar from deep roots to anchor on the ledge of a steep mountain.
